FIPS state alpha code identifies state (e.g. statecode = "DE" Delaware). See https://www.waterqualitydata.us/Codes/statecode options. Default = NULL. tmdl_date_end Character string. correspond ending date date range EPA approved official final TMDL submitted (date approval letter). Format "YYYY-MM-DD". Default = NULL. tmdl_date_start Character string. correspond starting date date range EPA approved official final TMDL submitted (date approval letter). Format "YYYY-MM-DD". Default = NULL. water_type Character string. Assessment Unit must least one water type, may multiple water types. Options can viewed EQ_DomainValues("water_type"). Default = NULL. ad_param Character string. context TMDL, Addressed Parameters refer associated parameters (parameters identified causes impairment Section 303(d) list later identified TMDL process) addressed pollutant TMDL.
